description: Change a connected channel's sync settings. Both switches apply to X channels only, where every read is billed, and each is off until turned on: metricsSyncEnabled turns on analytics sync (at most once every 7 days) and the list of people who liked a post; inboxSyncEnabled turns on direct messages and replies to the channel's posts. Send at least one. On a channel of any other platform the call succeeds but changes nothing. Needs a role that can manage channels (owner, admin, approver). Does not connect, reconnect or remove a channel. Use this when the user wants to turn analytics sync or direct-message/reply reading on or off for an X channel.

inboxSyncEnabled.description: X only. Turn reading direct messages and replies on or off. Omit to leave unchanged.

metricsSyncEnabled.description: X only. Turn analytics sync and liker lists on or off. Omit to leave unchanged.

name: update_channel
title: Update channel sync settings
